text.content:
The city's one badge, and on most streets the biggest gang.

Kind: Police: since the Purge, the city's only legal enforcement agency
Base: Precinct 1 (#69), the Glen. Precinct 2 (#83) Rancho Coronado, Precinct 3 (#4) Little China, Precinct 9 Coastview
Leadership: Commissioner Ramos. MaxTac: Commander Lorenzo "Contender" Lawrence
Purpose: Public safety, at large. Up close, easy jobs, PR disasters, and its cut

Since the second Purge Ordinance and the decades after it, the NCPD has held total control of law enforcement in Night City; the private district firms of the 2040s lost their contracts one by one, the last of them, Whitewater Security in Downtown, in 2069. Yet the end of the Unification War, and the failure in Pacifica, sit on the department like a stain. Respect for Commissioner Ramos is at an all-time low, and precincts increasingly look after themselves first.

The Department

  • Precincts. Precinct 1 (the Glen) is headquarters and covers City Center and Heywood; Precinct 2 (Rancho Coronado) covers Santo Domingo, where its captain plays golf with 6th Street's General; Precinct 3 (Little China) covers Watson and is badly understaffed; Precinct 9 in Coastview is the last one in Pacifica, still open without CitiNet service.
  • C-SWAT. The tactical teams. Honest, mostly, and busy with Maelstrom.
  • MaxTac. The cyberpsycho hunters, out of Wellsprings. With C-SWAT, the stalwarts of an honest institution.
  • Bounties. The NCPD still hires mercs for bounty work, paid on proof, and late.

The NCPD steps in when it's an easy job, when it's a giant PR liability, or when you get in the way of its cut. Stop-and-frisk is back in Downtown. In Pacifica it is desperately holding the line against Voodoo Boy and Barghest incursions, and the Commissioner fights with everything to avoid declaring Pacifica a combat zone, which would be an admission.

Common Charges, 2070

  • Carrying a pistol or blade without a permit: 100eb, weapon confiscated.
  • Unregistered cyberweapon: 500eb, removal ordered.
  • Heavy weapon or explosives: arrest, 1,000eb bail.
  • Assault: arrest, 500eb bail.
  • Gang association (first Purge Ordinance): arrest, 1,000eb bail. Rarely charged, always threatened.
  • Murder, or assaulting an officer: no bail.
  • Cyberpsychosis in public: MaxTac, if you live.

An arrest means a few days in a holding cell, unless you make bail or friends. Night City Prison in Arroyo has been over capacity since the Purge; half its inmates are association cases.

Other Law

Corporate security has full authority on corporate property. Arasaka Security is the only law on the Waterfront, Lazarus guards North Oak, Hansen's checkpoints rule the Occupied Zone, and the gangs are the de facto law in Vista del Rey, Rancho Coronado and parts of Pacifica.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.28; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 04, 10, 11, 12
